title: FLF PTFE Hose w/ Braided Nylon (50 Foot Roll)
description: Finish Line Factory’s PTFE Hose with Braided Nylon features an inner PTFE (Teflon) liner wrapped in a high-strength braided nylon outer cover. Designed specifically to handle harsh aggressive fuels like E85, ethanol, methanol, race gas, power steering fluid, and high-pressure oil lines without vapor permeation or breakdown.
